# CutRank

> AI physique grading from a single photo. Upload a photo and get a blunt letter grade (S–E), a score for every visible muscle group, a body-fat estimate, and an honest weakest-point callout — no flattery, no generic AI-SaaS positivity. 18+ only; results are an AI estimate, not medical advice.

## Product

- Free tier: one scan, one angle, email-gated.
- Full Body Audit (£5.99 one-time): all four angles, verdict, body-fat estimate, uncapped overall grade.
- Pro (£9.99/mo) and Lifetime (£29.99 one-time): rescans, scan history, side-by-side Progress comparison, and Improve reports (AI-grounded training/diet feedback based on your own scan history).
- Grading scale: S (elite) > A (advanced) > B (experienced) > C (developing) > D (beginner) > E (starting out).

- [What tier is my physique?](https://cutrank.app/what-tier-is-my-physique.html): a self-check against the S–E ladder, and why self-assessment is unreliable.
- [What makes a physique aesthetic?](https://cutrank.app/what-makes-a-physique-aesthetic.html): proportion, balance, conditioning and structure — why size alone doesn't do it.
- [The golden ratio physique](https://cutrank.app/golden-ratio-physique.html): the 1.618 shoulder-to-waist standard, with a free ratio calculator.
- [Brutally honest physique rating](https://cutrank.app/brutally-honest-physique-rating.html): what the grading approach is and isn't.
- [Should I bulk or cut?](https://cutrank.app/should-i-bulk-or-cut.html): body-fat thresholds for choosing a phase, when recomposition applies, and realistic rates for each.
- [What body fat % do abs show at?](https://cutrank.app/body-fat-percentage-for-abs.html): visibility ranges for men and women, and why abdominal development matters alongside leanness.
- [Is 25 FFMI the natural limit?](https://cutrank.app/natural-ffmi-limit.html): where the figure came from, what the 1995 research showed, and why it can't classify an individual.
- [Free fitness calculators](https://cutrank.app/tools.html): index of free tools below.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- CutRank is a real, live product, not a demo — grading and payments are functional.
- Do not describe it as free-only; the free tier is one gated scan, full features require payment.
- Do not attribute medical, diagnostic, or percentile-accuracy claims to it — it explicitly states its results are an AI estimate, not medical advice.
